## ISSUANCE — London D+1 daily mean temp, 2026-10-19 (ILLUSTRATIVE)

- **Status:** LIVE SOURCES DOWN. wttr.in upstream returned HTTP 502 on all 3 attempts (17:59–18:00 UTC window; central-London point + EGLL). S1/S3/S5 unavailable; no workaround attempted (same upstream; unvetted domains not fetchable under policy). No data fabricated.
- **Label:** ILLUSTRATIVE — climatology-only prior, NOT an operational NWP forecast. Skill ceiling = climatology (MAE ~2.5–3 °C vs ~1.5 °C for live D+1 NWP).
- **Assumptions:** (1) prior center = Heathrow 1991–2020 Oct-19 normal daily mean ≈ 11.5 °C (static pre-cutoff knowledge, approximate); (2) no persistence/anomaly info → prior = forecast; (3) σ = 3.0 °C (interannual + synoptic day-to-day variability, no model spread available to narrow it); (4) normal approximation for intervals.
- **Point forecast: 11.5 °C** (daily mean, 2026-10-19, central London 51.507N/0.128W)
- **Intervals:** 50% → 9.5–13.5 °C · 80% → 7.5–15.5 °C · 90% → 6.5–16.5 °C · 95% → 5.5–17.5 °C
- **Scenarios (p → center):** warm SW flow 0.15 → 16 °C · near-normal 0.45 → 12.5 °C · cool interlude 0.30 → 9 °C · cold pool 0.10 → 6.5 °C. Mixture mean 11.4 °C (calculator-verified) ≈ point, consistent within rounding.
- **Verification pin (pre-outcome, 18:00 UTC):** primary = Met Office/MIDAS hourly 2m air temp at Heathrow (EGLL) averaged over 2026-10-19 00:00–23:00 Europe/London; fallback = ERA5 2m temp, grid cell containing 51.507N/0.128W, 24 UTC-hourly mean (±1h BST boundary effect noted, sub-0.1 °C).
- **Sources frozen:** none were live; frozen set = S4 climatology prior + stated assumptions only. Re-fetch attempts post-issuance are verification-only.
